reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question cited Section 1604 travel distance to plastic-glazed openings, which is off-scope for an article limited to PD 1096 Rule VII Sec. 704 (Location on Property and Exterior Walls). Replaced with a Sec. 704-grounded question on measurement of street/alley centerline as adjacent property line.

checked_sources.label: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR (DPWH Official)
checked_sources.section_locator: Rule VII / Section 704.1 Location on Property

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 704.1(b)

proposed.text: For purposes of measuring distances under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 704(1)(b), how is the adjacent property line established when a building adjoins a street or alley?

options.text: At the far edge (far side) of the street or alley right-of-way
At the centerline of the adjoining street or alley
At the near edge (face of curb) of the street or alley
At the legal lot boundary only, regardless of street or alley

proposed.rationale: Section 704(1)(b) provides that, for purposes of this section, the centerline of an adjoining street or alley shall be considered an adjacent property line when applying the exterior-wall and opening-protection rules in Section 704.
proposed.explanation: Do not measure only from the legal lot boundary when a street or alley is involved; Section 704 uses the centerline convention for the specific exterior-wall rules in that section.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 704.1(b)
